verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Phaser is published as numbered releases on npm (4.2.1). It also notes that Phaser 2 code "likely won't work in Phaser 3". Neither of these is a documented deprecation policy or a versioned-API stability commitment. The /api/v1/examples endpoint versions an examples index, not Phaser's own API, so it is adjacent at most and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
